title: Storefront founder is about to sign a lease before knowing which approvals can delay opening
job: Know licensing, permitting, inspection and buildout dependencies before fixed costs start.
trigger: LOI or lease reaches signature stage.
surfaceComplaint: I do not know which city requirement is going to surprise me after rent starts.
mechanism: The costly failure is sequence: lease, use, buildout, permits, inspections and licenses interact across agencies. A wrong assumption can start rent before the business is operable.

economics.painCostNote: Each week of opening delay can burn rent, debt service and payroll while producing zero sales.

buyer.roiLogic: Small relative to one week of preventable delay.

competitors.gap: do not own operational opening sequence
official help can be general rather than site-specific pre-commitment analysis

intervention.notBuildYet: Do not compete with licensed architects/expediters.

experiment.success: 4/8 pay US$1k+ and half identify a material dependency before signing
experiment.kill: official concierge + advisors already solve pre-lease uncertainty

claims.text: NYC says small businesses continue to report permitting and licensing delays across agencies.
NYC launched 50+ reforms in 2026 to reduce small-business red tape.
The highest-value wedge may be before lease commitment rather than after an application is stuck.
